major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Trigger it roughly on cooldown, but only when you expect to stay in combat for at least 25 more seconds so the duration is not wasted.

major_cooldowns.name: Exploding Keg
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw it early in a pull for burst threat and a reset charge of Keg Smash, ideally with Rushing Jade Wind already active for bonus Fire damage on hit enemies.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table lists this as SAME NAME with id 388867; 325153 is the observed cast id. Talent node, not taken in every build.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of Death
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as a guaranteed execute once the target drops low enough, or hold it while the target's health is still above your own max health to snipe triple damage.

major_cooldowns.name: Black Ox Brew
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Activate it whenever you can avoid wasting the Purifying Brew and Celestial Brew or Celestial Infusion charges it instantly refills; it does not use the global cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Talent node, cast in 4 of 5 sampled parses.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Use it before you expect to take a large hit rather than saving it, since casting Keg Smash and Tiger Palm keeps cutting its recharge time throughout the fight; if you have no defensive need, its health bonus still buffs Touch of Death.
defensives.id_note: SAME NAME as ids 120954 (the buff aura) and 388917 (the talented version referenced throughout the guide); 115203 is the observed cast id.

defensives.name: Purifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Treat its two charges as one: keep a charge banked for Elevated Stagger spikes and spend the other as your second charge is about to finish recharging, rather than letting both sit ready.
defensives.id_note: Table's base_cd_s is blank; the guide states an explicit 20-second recharge per charge, used here instead.

defensives.name: Celestial Infusion
defensives.usage_rule: Activate it often, even against light damage, especially at two charges or near-full vitality, to trigger Harmonic Surge and generate an Empty Barrel for your next Keg Smash.
defensives.id_note: Master of Harmony hero-talent variant of Celestial Brew (spell=322507, not in the ability table); only cast when that hero tree is chosen.

defensives.name: Expel Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Save your Healing Spheres up to around three before you use it to collect them, and only spend it when your health is dropping or a dangerous hit is coming.

rules.description: Open with Breath of Fire, Keg Smash, Blackout Kick
rules.action: Precast Breath of Fire before the pull, then open with Keg Smash into Blackout Kick, Tiger Palm, and Exploding Keg.

rules.description: Spinning Crane Kick only against multiple targets
rules.action: Save Spinning Crane Kick for pulls with several enemies instead of spamming it against a single target.

rules.description: Keep Breath of Fire's debuff active on the target
rules.action: Refresh Breath of Fire before its damage-reduction debuff falls off the target.
